# Known bugs that GoogleSQL's compliance tests (`just compliance`) or BigQuery's answers to
# unverified cases found. Each case gives BigQuery's answer after `!>`, which the emulator does
# not give yet: the case passes while the emulator answers otherwise. Every one of them is to be fixed; a fix fails its case, which then
# moves to the file of its function, written with `=>`.
#
# Inputs come from UNNEST so that the analyzer cannot fold the expression into a constant, which
# it evaluates correctly.

# BigQuery reports where the exception was thrown; QuickJS keeps only where an Error was created.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "throw new Error('boom');";
SELECT f()
!> error: Error: boom at f() line 1, column 1

# An empty GEOGRAPHY is unsupported.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY')
!> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

# CREATE TABLE AS SELECT rounds the values it writes with the rounding modes its columns have when
# it is translated, before the dataset's default gives a parameterized column ROUND_HALF_EVEN, so
# the emulator rejects it.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_rounding_even.ctas_parameterized (n NUMERIC(5, 1)) AS SELECT NUMERIC '2.25' AS n;
SELECT CAST(n AS STRING) FROM scalars_rounding_even.ctas_parameterized
!> "2.2"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_rounding_even.ctas_negative (n NUMERIC(5, 1)) AS SELECT NUMERIC '-2.25' AS n;
SELECT CAST(n AS STRING) FROM scalars_rounding_even.ctas_negative
!> "-2.2"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars_rounding_even.ctas_bignumeric (n BIGNUMERIC(10, 0)) AS SELECT BIGNUMERIC '2.5' AS n;
SELECT CAST(n AS STRING) FROM scalars_rounding_even.ctas_bignumeric
!> "2"
